failure: Any precondition or installation error rolls back the whole transaction. Unknown COMMIT requires receipt recovery, never blind reapply.

consumerBoundary.rowBinding: Trusted parser supplies validated material, exact rowBindings for ALL entries and digest-bound media envelope to freeze_sop_parsed_candidate; it atomically freezes the job and candidate, vocabulary, rows and media. read_sop_inherited_assets returns authorized exact predecessor provenance. Row/media helpers are owner-internal.
consumerBoundary.command: Existing transaction/receipt owner maps request to revise_unused_sop_row, enforces path/key identity and returns IntakeCandidate. Never expose actor body or database result directly.
consumerBoundary.preview: On unknown commit retain operationId and preview; durable response and rowIds apply only to their candidate version. Read immutable release-media bindings only after the existing session/lease/source authorization, filter each row before deduplication, then verify one private payload. Missing or corrupted bytes fail closed; no cache fallback.
consumerBoundary.payload: Same job/media reservation returns the same private object. sop-media shares the existing tenant quota; immutable files and database adoption are separate recoverable steps. Filesystem object locks cover writes and reclaim independently of database connectivity; crashed locks remain busy and charged, with no automatic TTL reclaim.
consumerBoundary.publication: One statement-level release_lineage trigger projects exact row media in the same publish/rollback/inheritance transaction. Shared images retain distinct row bindings; missing provenance or payload rejects the entire publication. Existing frozen migrations remain unchanged.
blocked: production parser must adopt the bounded freeze function after versioned intake; no broad business table write grant
inherited material must carry reliable complete row mapping and explicitly inherited media; unbound history fails closed
